history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration coordinate with the United Nations Foundation to determine how the parties to the relationship agreement can coordinate regarding the high administrative expenses of the Foundation to ensure that funds are used more efficiently for United Nations causes.
history.administration_response: The United Nations Foundation has provided the United Nations Office for Partnerships with data from two trusted and verified third-party sources that track and capture the latest industry standards for non-profit administrative expenses. The data shared with the Board demonstrate that the United Nations Foundation’s executive compensation levels are below industry standards when considering the size of the Foundation and its geography. The United Nations Office for Partnerships is satisfied that the data provide sufficient justification for addressing the Board’s recommendation and requests that it be closed.
history.board_assessment: Given that the Administration has conducted a review of the level of the United Nations Foundation’s administrative expenses, the Board considers this recommendation implemented.
